scientific_integrity: An all-size direct proof and a reproducible finite checker are provided. Finite checks corroborate but do not independently certify the result.
scientific_limitations: Only finite side-labelled chain graphs, open neighborhoods, and unlabelled marked-host isomorphisms; connected extremal isomorphism counts are not claimed; absolute historical priority not established.
title: Sharp marked-type saturation and minimum-host rigidity in finite chain graphs
